import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class SSP {
        int n, source, sink;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges;

        static class Edge {
            int u, flow, cap, cost, origcost;
            Edge(int u, int cap, int cost) {
                this.u = u;
                this.flow = 0;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
                this.origcost = cost;
            }
        }

        static class Pair {
            int first, second;
            Pair(int f, int s) {
                first = f;
                second = s;
            }
        }

        SSP(int n, int source, int sink) {
            this.n = n;
            this.source = source;
            this.sink = sink;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int add_edge(int a, int b, int cap, int cost) {
            int result = edges.size();
            adj.get(a).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(b, cap, cost));
            adj.get(b).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(a, 0, -cost));
            return result;
        }

        Pair djk() {
            int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            int[] prev = new int[n];
            int[] maxf = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            Arrays.fill(prev, -1);
            prev[source] = -2;
            maxf[source] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            dist[source] = 0;

            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, source});

            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] cur = pq.poll();
                int d = cur[0], v = cur[1];
                if (d != dist[v]) continue;
                for (int edid : adj.get(v)) {
                    Edge ed = edges.get(edid);
                    if (ed.flow < ed.cap && dist[ed.u] > dist[v] + ed.cost) {
                        dist[ed.u] = dist[v] + ed.cost;
                        prev[ed.u] = edid;
                        maxf[ed.u] = Math.min(maxf[v], ed.cap - ed.flow);
                        pq.offer(new int[]{dist[ed.u], ed.u});
                    }
                }
            }

            int lastid = prev[sink];
            if (lastid == -1) return new Pair(0, 0);
            int extraflow = maxf[sink];
            int atcost = 0;
            for (int id = lastid; id != -2; id = prev[edges.get(id ^ 1).u]) {
                Edge ed = edges.get(id);
                ed.flow += extraflow;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= extraflow;
                atcost += ed.origcost;
            }
            for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
                int u = edges.get(id).u;
                if (prev[v] != -1 && prev[u] != -1) {
                    edges.get(id).cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
                }
            }
            return new Pair(extraflow, atcost);
        }

        Pair mfmc() {
            int flow = 0, cost = 0;
            boolean needBellman = false;
            for (Edge ed : edges) {
                if (ed.flow > 0 && ed.cost < 0) {
                    needBellman = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (needBellman) bellmanford();
            while (true) {
                Pair p = djk();
                int extraflow = p.first;
                if (extraflow == 0) break;
                flow += extraflow;
                cost += extraflow * p.second;
            }
            return new Pair(flow, cost);
        }

        void bellmanford() {
            int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[source] = 0;
            for (int rep = 0; rep < n; rep++) {
                boolean changed = false;
                for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                    int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
                    int u = edges.get(id).u;
                    if (edges.get(id).flow < edges.get(id).cap && dist[v] != INF &&
                        dist[u] > dist[v] + edges.get(id).cost) {
                        dist[u] = dist[v] + edges.get(id).cost;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                if (!changed) break;
            }
            for (int id = 0; id < edges.size(); id++) {
                int v = edges.get(id ^ 1).u;
                int u = edges.get(id).u;
                if (dist[v] < INF && dist[u] < INF) {
                    edges.get(id).cost += dist[v] - dist[u];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int max_time = 120;
        int[] a = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        List<Integer>[] e = new ArrayList[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            e[x].add(y);
            e[y].add(x);
        }
        int nd = 0;
        int[][] to = new int[max_time][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < max_time; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                to[i][j] = nd++;
            }
        }
        int S = nd++;
        int T = nd++;
        SSP flow = new SSP(nd, S, T);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            flow.add_edge(S, to[0][a[i]], 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < max_time; i++) {
            flow.add_edge(to[i][1], T, k, c * i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < max_time - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int neighbor : e[j]) {
                    for (int z = 0; z <= 52; z++) {
                        flow.add_edge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][neighbor], 1, d * (2 * z + 1));
                    }
                }
                flow.add_edge(to[i][j], to[i + 1][j], k, 0);
            }
        }
        SSP.Pair result = flow.mfmc();
        System.out.println(result.second);
        sc.close();
    }
}
